description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TikTok is a short-form mobile video platform focused on inspiring creativity and bringing joy. The company is seeking a graduate Software Development Engineer to support system testing, automation, functional validation, software defect tracking, and release-related activities for its centralized Testing team.
Graduate software test engineer developing test cases, tracking defects, and supporting automation frameworks and continuous delivery

Responsibilities:
• Participate in the entire system testing process under guidance, including requirement analysis, designing and executing basic test plans/cases, and tracking software defects through resolution
• Assist in project execution, tracking risk items, and maintaining test execution processes
• Learn and apply existing test tools, and collaborate with automation/performance engineers to develop and maintain internal tools, test frameworks, and continuous delivery platforms to improve overall team productivity

Requirements:
• Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline
• Strong foundational programming skills in Java, Python, Objective-C, or Golang through academic projects, coursework, or internships
• Fundamental understanding of test automation concepts and basic experience with API, mobile, or web testing tools
• Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture principles
• Interest or academic project experience in leveraging AI/LLM tools or prompt engineering to improve code quality or testing efficiency

Preferred:
• Coursework or project experience in evaluating/testing AI Agent/LLM outputs or model behavior
• Basic familiarity with web frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask) or container/distributed tech concepts (e.g., Docker, K8s, Kafka, Redis)
• Previous internship or research experience in software testing, QA automation, or mobile/web development
• Strong passion for mobile internet products and building next-generation applications
• Excellent problem-solving skills, strong curiosity, and a collaborative mindset for working across cross-functional and global teams
